concepts.name: 33-wedge-chevron
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: one new minimal bold geometric brand icon for kollens.
Input images: all four images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, not edit targets and not shapes to copy exactly. Use their solid optical K construction and restrained filled masses. Exclude every watermark, word, credit, TM and background panel from the references.
Direction: WEDGE CHEVRON. Construct a compact asymmetrical abstract optical K from exactly TWO large filled pieces: one bold rising triangular facet on the left, and one broad left-facing folded chevron on the right. Largely sharp deliberate geometry inspired by the second reference, but create original footprint and proportions. Make the left triangle substantial, the right chevron equally bold, and give their meeting region a clean generous negative-space separation. Controlled 45-degree slopes, crisp flat tips, few vertices, strong filled silhouette, no thin strokes.
Color and framing: flat exact gold #F9C932, one centered icon approximately 60% of a square canvas width, plain near-black charcoal #101113 background, generous margins.
The three-dimensional word 'folded' means a two-dimensional graphic bend only: no 3D, perspective, shading, gradient or lighting. No text, wordmark, TM, watermark, frame, collage, texture, grain, glow, shadows, mockup, outlines, extra elements, coins or circuitry.
Precision-first logo design, recognisable at 24 pixels with generous open cuts.

concepts.name: 34-flow-chevron
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: one new minimal bold geometric brand icon for kollens.
Input images: all four images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, not edit targets or exact shapes to copy. Learn the abstract K optical construction, filled masses, and softened segmented folds. Remove every watermark, word, credit, TM and reference panel.
Direction: FLOW CHEVRON. Create exactly THREE solid pieces forming an original compact abstract K: one thick right folded left-facing chevron with one controlled rounded inside bend, plus two smaller complementary upper-left and lower-left facets. Follow coherent 45-degree slopes and broad flat tip faces. The two left facets should echo the right fold, with calm deliberate soft transitions at their inward fold points, generous negative-space cuts and chunky strong planes. Inspired primarily by the third reference, with a fresh silhouette and proportions. Distinctive compared with a simple triangle plus sharp chevron.
Style and composition: precise geometric vector-like logo, flat exact gold #F9C932 on a plain near-black charcoal #101113 square background. Single centered icon about 60% of the canvas width, generous margins. Make curves circular and controlled, geometry symmetric where intended, no ragged or wobbly edges.
The word 'folded' describes a flat graphic bend only, not a 3D object. No text, TM, watermark, frame, outline, gradient, grain, texture, lighting, shadows, glow, perspective, 3D, mockup or extra elements.
Three filled masses only, recognizable at 24 pixels, with clear generous separated pieces.
